WITH days AS (SELECT calendar_date AS sale_date FROM dim_date WHERE calendar_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-15' AND DATE '2025-12-23'),
sales AS (SELECT sale_date, sum(net_amount) AS gross_of_returns FROM fact_sales_line WHERE channel_id IN (2,3) AND sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-15' AND DATE '2025-12-23' GROUP BY 1),
refunds AS (SELECT r.return_date AS sale_date, sum(r.refund_net) AS returns_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-15' AND DATE '2025-12-23' GROUP BY 1)
SELECT d.sale_date, COALESCE(s.gross_of_returns,0) - COALESCE(r.returns_net,0) AS net_sales, s.gross_of_returns AS before_returns, r.returns_net
FROM days d LEFT JOIN sales s USING (sale_date) LEFT JOIN refunds r USING (sale_date) ORDER BY 1
